Apple today unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, its latest flagship models. Below is a rundown of all the new features of the iPhone 18 Pro compared to last year's iPhone 17 Pro.

Camera: New 48-megapixel main camera with variable aperture

Apple improves the iPhone camera system every year. However, with four different cameras on the Pro models, sometimes the changes are limited to just one. Last year, for example, brought a new Center Stage front camera and telephoto improvements.

With the iPhone 18 Pro, Apple's upgrades are focused on the main camera.

Apple says the biggest highlight of the new 48-megapixel Fusion main camera is the addition of a variable aperture. Details:

Users can switch between different aperture values: ƒ/1.48, ƒ/1.8, ƒ/2.8 and ƒ/4.0.

Apple has also introduced several new software features in the Camera app, including an updated "Photographic Styles," as well as professional controls for lens aperture, shutter speed, white balance and viewing a histogram. These features are exclusive to the iPhone 18 Pro, as are Smart Focus Tracking, Cinematic mode for video, and Apple Reference Image.

Performance: A20 Pro chip and thermal upgrades

The new A20 Pro chip brings major improvements over last year's A19 Pro, in part thanks to a new 2nm process, boosting both performance and energy efficiency.

The A20 Pro features a 6-core CPU, including 2 new-generation efficiency cores that Apple calls the fastest ever in a smartphone, plus 4 new efficiency cores. The GPU is 7-core, delivering 40% faster graphics performance than the A19 Pro, with higher bandwidth and a faster Neural Accelerator.

With iOS 27 packing a lot of important AI features, the A20 Pro brings especially notable AI improvements, thanks to a new dual 16-core Neural Engine, doubling the core count of the A19 Pro.

Finally, the A20 Pro has 50% more memory bandwidth, and thermal performance has been improved with a second-generation vapor chamber. These changes ultimately deliver 40% better sustained performance than the iPhone 17 Pro.

Design: New colors, unified back design, redesigned Dynamic Island

The iPhone 18 Pro largely continues the design language of the iPhone 17 Pro, with the same protruding camera plateau on the back.

The most obvious design change this time is in colors. The iPhone 18 Pro comes in four new shades: Wine Red, Glacial, Black and Silver. Compared to the bold palette of the iPhone 17 Pro, this offers a fresh new look.

Apple has also updated the iPhone 18 Pro's back design, with a more unified color scheme between the glass cutout and the aluminum frame. Last year's model used a two-tone design, but this year offers a more cohesive overall look.

Finally, the front of the iPhone 18 Pro features a redesigned Dynamic Island that takes up less space and can display up to three Live Activities at once.

Battery: Best-ever battery life, faster charging

The iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max already offered the best iPhone battery life ever. But Apple has extended battery life again this year, with the biggest gains on the iPhone 18 Pro Max.

Battery Life (video playback) iPhone 18 Pro up to 36 hours iPhone 18 Pro Max up to 45 hours iPhone 17 Pro up to 33 hours iPhone 17 Pro Max up to 39 hours

The iPhone 18 Pro also supports faster wired charging, reaching 50% in just 15 minutes.

Connectivity: At least the 18 Pro gets Apple's own C2 modem

Apple's all-new in-house C2 modem debuts on the iPhone 18 Pro, replacing the Qualcomm modem used in the iPhone 17 Pro, while continuing to support mmWave in the US market.

Here are the details from Apple's press release:

Interestingly, Apple's tech specs page suggests the C2 may be limited to just the iPhone 18 Pro, with the Pro Max continuing to use a Qualcomm modem.

iPhone 18 Pro vs iPhone 17 Pro: The bottom line

Top-rated comment from Kiriakos Alexiou

I've been upgrading every year for 15 years, and this is one I'll be skipping. It doesn't make much of a difference for my everyday use, and the Duo is priced too high, missing some features as a flagship iPhone. The Duo presentation at the event was quite enticing, but in hindsight, it's still a no.

The iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199, up from $1,099 for the iPhone 17 Pro. The iPhone 18 Pro Max also gets a $100 price hike, starting at $1,299.

Are you planning to upgrade from the iPhone 17 Pro to the iPhone 18 Pro? Why or why not? Let us know in the comments.
